# Gorelo MCP tool catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_tool_catalog.py from the tool registry. Do not edit by hand. -->

This file is generated. After any change to a tool (its name, toolset, kind, ops, parameters or the first
sentence of its docstring), and after merging branches that touch `tools/`, regenerate it:

```bash
uv run --frozen python scripts/gen_tool_catalog.py
```

`tests/test_tool_catalog.py` fails when the committed file differs from a fresh generation.

The registry holds 89 tools in 7 toolsets. A server started with the default settings (toolsets core, tickets, time, billing, uptime; GORELO_ENABLE_DESTRUCTIVE off, so no gated tool: no delete or void tool and no `create_approved_invoice`) registers 58 of them.

How to read it:

- Toolsets are chosen with `GORELO_TOOLSETS` (a comma list, or `all`). Default: core, tickets, time, billing, uptime.
- Kind `read` changes nothing in Gorelo. `write` creates or changes data. `write (overwrites data)` also replaces or clears data that already exists (the MCP destructiveHint is set). `destructive` tools are the delete and void tools and `create_approved_invoice` (it creates an invoice that is Approved at once, so Gorelo pushes it to the connected accounting system and may email its recipients): they are registered only when GORELO_ENABLE_DESTRUCTIVE=1, and every call also needs `confirm=true`.
- Ops are the Gorelo operations (`METHOD /v1/path`) the tool may call. Any other operation is refused before any HTTP request.
- Required params are the parameters a call must supply. Every other parameter is optional.
- What it does is the first sentence of the tool description; the full text is what claude.ai reads.

## core

In the default set.

| Tool | Kind | Ops | Required params | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `create_client` | write | `POST /v1/clients` | `name`, `location_name` | Create a client together with its default location; returns the created client record. |
| `create_contact` | write | `POST /v1/contacts` | `client_id`, `first_name`, `last_name`, `primary_email` | Create a contact under a client; returns the created contact record. |
| `get_agent` | read | `GET /v1/assets/agents/{deviceId}` | `agent_id` | Get one agent (managed device) by UUID; returns Gorelo's full device record. |
| `get_client` | read | `GET /v1/clients/{clientId}` | `client_id` | Get one client by id; returns Gorelo's client record. |
| `get_contact` | read | `GET /v1/contacts/{contactId}` | `contact_id` | Get one contact by id; returns Gorelo's contact record (SecondaryEmail is never included). |
| `health_check` | read | `GET /v1/clients` | none | Check the Gorelo API answers and this server understands it; returns {ok, api, total_clients, toolsets, destructive, spec_sha256}. |
| `list_agents` | read | `GET /v1/assets/agents` | none | List agents (managed devices) one page per call; returns {items, has_more, next_cursor, total_count, ...}. |
| `list_alerts` | read | `GET /v1/alerts` | none | List alerts raised in Gorelo, including those sent with post_alert, one page at a time: newest first unless sort_order is asc. |
| `list_client_locations` | read | `GET /v1/clients/{clientId}/locations` | `client_id` | List every location of one client (not paged); returns {items, count}. |
| `list_clients` | read | `GET /v1/clients` | none | List clients one page per call; returns {items, has_more, next_cursor, total_count, ...}. |
| `list_contacts` | read | `GET /v1/contacts` | none | List contacts one page per call; returns {items, has_more, next_cursor, total_count, ...}. |
| `list_custom_assets` | read | `GET /v1/assets/custom` | none | List custom (non-agent) assets one page per call; returns {items, has_more, next_cursor, total_count, ...}. |
| `list_org_groups` | read | `GET /v1/organization/groups` | none | List every technician group (not paged); returns {items, count}. |
| `list_org_users` | read | `GET /v1/organization/users` | none | List every user (technician); all pages are read for you. |
| `post_alert` | write | `POST /v1/alerts` | `name`, `client_id`, `resource`, `severity` | Post an external alert for a client's resource; returns {"ok": true} when Gorelo accepts it. |
| `update_client` | write (overwrites data) | `PATCH /v1/clients/{clientId}` | `client_id` | Update a client's name, status, billing name or alternate name; returns the updated client record. |
| `update_contact` | write (overwrites data) | `GET /v1/contacts/{contactId}`, `PATCH /v1/contacts/{contactId}` | `contact_id` | Update a contact; returns the updated contact record. |

## tickets

In the default set.

| Tool | Kind | Ops | Required params | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `create_ticket` | write | `POST /v1/tickets`, `GET /v1/tickets/{ticketId}` | `title`, `description`, `client_id`, `status_id`, `type_id`, `priority_id`, `source_id`, `group_id` | Create a ticket and return its full record. |
| `create_ticket_approval` | write | `POST /v1/tickets/{ticketId}/conversations/approval`, `GET /v1/tickets/{ticketId}/approvals/{approvalId}` | `ticket_id`, `name`, `contact_ids` | Create an approval on a ticket and return it with its approvers, all Pending. |
| `create_ticket_comment` | write | `POST /v1/tickets/{ticketId}/comments`, `GET /v1/tickets/{ticketId}/comments/{commentId}` | `ticket_id`, `body` | Add a comment to a ticket and return it. |
| `create_ticket_side_conversation` | write | `POST /v1/tickets/{ticketId}/conversations/side-conversation` | `ticket_id`, `name`, `email` | Create a side conversation (email thread with an outside address) on a ticket and return its Id. |
| `delete_ticket_comment` | destructive (only when GORELO_ENABLE_DESTRUCTIVE=1) | `DELETE /v1/tickets/{ticketId}/comments/{commentId}` | `ticket_id`, `comment_id` | Delete one PRIVATE comment and return Gorelo's {Id}. |
| `get_ticket` | read | `GET /v1/tickets/{ticketId}`, `GET /v1/tickets` | `ticket_id` | Get one ticket in full: the list fields plus Description, Time, Products, BillingOverride, Shipments, Banner and linked asset and uptime ids. |
| `get_ticket_approval` | read | `GET /v1/tickets/{ticketId}/approvals/{approvalId}` | `ticket_id`, `approval_id` | Get one approval on a ticket with its approvers; this is where approval status lives (Pending, Approved, Disapproved: Disapproved as soon as anyone disapproves, Approved once all approve). |
| `get_ticket_comment` | read | `GET /v1/tickets/{ticketId}/comments/{commentId}` | `ticket_id`, `comment_id` | Get one ticket comment in full (HTML body, author, attachments, email status). |
| `list_ticket_comments` | read | `GET /v1/tickets/{ticketId}/comments` | `ticket_id` | List a ticket's comments, one page at a time. |
| `list_ticket_conversations` | read | `GET /v1/tickets/{ticketId}/conversations` | `ticket_id` | List a ticket's conversations in one call: the Public and Private main thread (null Id) plus each side conversation and approval, whose Id is the conversation_id for comments or the approval_id for get_ticket_approval. |
| `list_ticket_priorities` | read | `GET /v1/tickets` | none | List the ticket priorities: 0 None, 1 Urgent, 2 High, 3 Normal, 4 Low. |
| `list_ticket_sources` | read | `GET /v1/tickets` | none | List the ticket sources for create_ticket: 1 Web, 2 Email, 3 Phone, 4 Chat, 5 Alert, 6 Api. |
| `list_ticket_statuses` | read | `GET /v1/tickets/statuses` | none | List the tenant's ticket statuses (Id, Name, ...) for status ids. |
| `list_ticket_tags` | read | `GET /v1/tickets/tags` | none | List the tenant's ticket tags (Id, Name, ...) for tag ids. |
| `list_ticket_types` | read | `GET /v1/tickets/types` | none | List the tenant's ticket types (Id, Name, ...) for type ids. |
| `list_tickets` | read | `GET /v1/tickets` | none | List one page of tickets, newest update first unless sorted. |
| `search_tickets` | read | `GET /v1/tickets`, `GET /v1/tickets/statuses`, `GET /v1/tickets/types` | none | Find tickets by client, status, priority, type, text, dates and waiting, unassigned, unread or open state, scanning every matching page. |
| `update_ticket` | write (overwrites data) | `PATCH /v1/tickets/{ticketId}`, `GET /v1/tickets/{ticketId}` | `ticket_id` | Change fields of a ticket and return its full record. |
| `upload_attachment` | write | `POST /v1/attachments` | `item_type`, `item_id`, `filename` | Upload a file to a ticket, task or project; returns name and url to pass, together and unchanged, in a comment's attachments (the result's note names the tool). |

## projects

Not in the default set: add it to `GORELO_TOOLSETS`. Needs the `Project` scope on the Gorelo API key (a 403 with code 080203 means it is missing).

| Tool | Kind | Ops | Required params | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `create_project` | write | `POST /v1/projects`, `GET /v1/projects/{projectId}` | `title`, `client_id`, `location_id`, `type_id`, `group_id` | Create a project and return its record. |
| `create_project_comment` | write | `POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/comments`, `POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}/comments`, `GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/comments/{commentId}`, `GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}/comments/{commentId}` | `project_id`, `body` | Post a comment on a project, or on one task when task_id is given, and return the created comment. |
| `create_project_section` | write | `POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/sections` | `project_id`, `title` | Add a section (board column) to a project and return its Id. |
| `create_project_task` | write | `POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/tasks`, `GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}` | `project_id`, `title`, `section_id` | Create a task on a project's board and return its record. |
| `create_task_approval` | write | `POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}/conversations/approval`, `GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}/approvals/{approvalId}` | `project_id`, `task_id`, `name`, `contact_ids` | Ask contacts to approve something on a task and return the approval. |
| `create_task_side_conversation` | write | `POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}/conversations/side-conversation` | `project_id`, `task_id`, `name`, `email` | Start a side conversation on a task, a thread with somebody outside its own contacts, and return its Id. |
| `delete_project_comment` | destructive (only when GORELO_ENABLE_DESTRUCTIVE=1) | `DELETE /v1/projects/{projectId}/comments/{commentId}`, `DELETE /v1/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}/comments/{commentId}` | `project_id`, `comment_id` | Delete one PRIVATE comment of a project, or of one task when task_id is given. |
| `delete_project_task` | destructive (only when GORELO_ENABLE_DESTRUCTIVE=1) | `DELETE /v1/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}` | `project_id`, `task_id` | Delete one task of a project. |
| `get_project` | read | `GET /v1/projects/{projectId}` | `project_id` | Get one project's full record, including Description, SharedWithContactIds and WatcherIds. |
| `get_project_comment` | read | `GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/comments/{commentId}`, `GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}/comments/{commentId}` | `project_id`, `comment_id` | Get one comment of a project, or of one task when task_id is given, with its full body. |
| `get_project_task` | read | `GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}` | `project_id`, `task_id` | Get one task in full: linked assets and uptime checks, blocking relationships (both directions), status reason and details, recorded time, products and banner, plus the IsUnread and IsWaitingOnThem flags. |
| `get_task_approval` | read | `GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}/approvals/{approvalId}` | `project_id`, `task_id`, `approval_id` | Get one approval on a task with its approvers. |
| `list_project_comments` | read | `GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/comments`, `GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}/comments` | `project_id` | List a project's comments, newest first, or one task's comments when task_id is given. |
| `list_project_sections` | read | `GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/sections` | `project_id` | List a project's sections (board columns) with Id, Title, Color and TaskCount. |
| `list_project_tags` | read | `GET /v1/projects/tags` | none | List every project tag (Id, Name, Description). |
| `list_project_tasks` | read | `GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/tasks` | `project_id` | List a project's tasks, in the board's own order by default, and return one page. |
| `list_project_types` | read | `GET /v1/projects/types` | none | List every project type (Id, Name, Description). |
| `list_projects` | read | `GET /v1/projects` | none | List projects, newest activity first by default, and return one page. |
| `list_task_conversations` | read | `GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}/conversations` | `project_id`, `task_id` | List a task's conversations (Id, Type, Name, Email, CcEmails, CreatedOn). |
| `update_project` | write (overwrites data) | `PATCH /v1/projects/{projectId}`, `GET /v1/projects/{projectId}` | `project_id` | Change fields of one project and return its updated record. |
| `update_project_section` | write (overwrites data) | `PATCH /v1/projects/{projectId}/sections/{sectionId}` | `project_id`, `section_id` | Rename or recolour one section and return its Id. |
| `update_project_task` | write (overwrites data) | `PATCH /v1/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}`, `GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}` | `project_id`, `task_id` | Change fields of one task and return its updated record. |

## forms

Not in the default set: add it to `GORELO_TOOLSETS`. Needs the `Forms` scope on the Gorelo API key (a 403 with code 080203 means it is missing).

| Tool | Kind | Ops | Required params | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `create_form_submission_link` | write | `POST /v1/forms/{formId}/submission-links` | `form_id` | Issue a submission link for a form and return {Link, ExpiresOn}. |
| `list_form_responses` | read | `GET /v1/forms/{formId}/responses` | `form_id` | List a form's submitted responses, newest first, one page at a time. |
| `list_forms` | read | `GET /v1/forms` | none | List forms, most recently updated first by default, one page at a time. |
